scope: CDS landmark isolation test; no runtime geometry or terrain changes
cause: Adding surveyed 580/566/560 Commonwealth records to BU_FULL_BUILDINGS legitimately changes legacy building-derived height interpolation/pads around Questrom. The original entire-campus frozen signature unintentionally froze neighbouring ground heights.

diagnosis.method: In-memory esbuild A/B with only bu-full-layout.ts read from HEAD:e2ec8c3 restores original signature. Replacing only the entire bu-terrain.ts with HEAD does not alter the current signature. Per-mesh Float32 attribute comparison locates the complete delta.
diagnosis.unchanged: All CDS mesh attributes, all neighbouring architecture, every X/Z component, UV, campusBaseHeight, campusYaw, triangle count/winding and mesh count. The other 36 meshes have identical attributes.

testCorrection.historicalSignatures: CDS: 22590 triangles/10 meshes; neighbouring architecture: 83242 triangles/21 meshes; neighbouring ground plan: 4470 triangles/8 meshes. All three signatures independently computed with HEAD layout, then verified identical with current layout. Together retain all original 110302 triangles/39 meshes.
testCorrection.terrainContract: Ground plan signature excludes only Y/normal; live Questrom surface offsets and finite-difference slope normals are independently checked against current buElevation, with 0.1 mm position tolerance for Float32 geometry. Existing hiding tests still hash every non-CDS triangle/attribute before and after hiding CDS.
testCorrection.visualAcceptance: Not applicable: this records technical test scope, not visual acceptance.
